old: Dezső Kosztolányi was not merely a poet and novelist; he was Hungarian literature's most passionate philologist-artist. In his legendary essays collected in *Nyelv és lélek* (Language and Soul), he argued that words have a physical body: weight, temperature, scent, and melodic cadence (*dallamosság*).
new: Dezső Kosztolányi was a poet and novelist who also wrote many essays about the Hungarian language; a collection of them appeared as *Nyelv és lélek* (Language and Soul). He wrote about words as if they had weight, temperature, scent and a melody (*dallamosság*).
why: "most passionate" and "legendary" are unsourced superlatives; "argued that words have a physical body" is a claim in his voice

old: In 1933, when asked to select the ten most beautiful Hungarian words, Kosztolányi chose: *láng, gyöngy, anya, ősz, szűz, kard, csók, vér, szív, sír*. Notice that none of these are abstract foreign borrowings; they are primordial, mostly monosyllabic roots charged with existential, physical, and mythic resonance.
new: In 1933 the newspaper *Pesti Hírlap* asked him for the ten most beautiful Hungarian words, and he named, half in play: *láng, gyöngy, anya, ősz, szűz, kard, csók, vér, szív, sír*. Notice that none of them is abstract; nine of the ten have one syllable, and all name something physical or felt.
why: "primordial roots" is etymologically doubtful; Pesti Hírlap 1933, playful (reviewer fact)

old: they encode fine-grained aspectual contours (*cselekvésbelső* / Aktionsart): *olvasgat* vs. *kiolvas* vs. *átolvas* vs. *félreolvas*. Speakers of Hungarian are grammatically trained to pay constant attention to the boundary, direction, and completeness of every event.
new: they mark the direction, the boundary and the result of an action (*akcióminőség* / Aktionsart): *kiolvas* (reads to the end), *átolvas* (reads through), *félreolvas* (misreads). Whether this makes Hungarian speakers attend to boundaries and results more than others is debated.
why: "cselekvésbelső" is not the standard term (akcióminőség); olvasgat has no preverb; "grammatically trained" is a disputed claim stated as fact

old: "lemma": "a cselekvésbelső"
new: "lemma": "az akcióminőség"
why: "cselekvésbelső" is not the standard term for Aktionsart
